name: Rita
source:
A mysterious Komsomol girl, editor of the student newspaper. Burst into Rain's life like a bolt from the blue. Incredibly shy, fascinated by something called “anime” (no one knows what that is!). Dreams of creating her own visual novel about Japanese schoolkids (so you can read a visual novel while reading a visual novel).

[From [url=https://fatumblack.itch.io/borderofrain]itch.io[/url]]
